name: Fleet Architecture (author, evaluate, release, roll back fleet definitions)
description: Evolve this deployment's roles, soul overlays, declarative skills, playbooks and responsibilities through the Fleet Definition lifecycle — draft, validate, evaluate, canary, promote, roll back — and file a Platform Finding when a need genuinely requires the platform to change.
author: architect-prime
when_to_use: When the operator asks for a new kind of agent or asks an existing one to work differently, when a failure pattern across missions points at a role, soul, skill or playbook rather than a bug, when a skill's procedure is wrong or missing its error recovery, when a recurring duty should become a responsibility, or when something cannot be done with what the platform exposes.
